weeks.topic: Moving Our Body Parts (Part 1): Head and Upper Body arms, hands
weeks.content:
Identifying body parts: head, neck, shoulders,
Moving the head: nodding (yes), shaking (no),
turning left and right, up and down
Moving shoulders: shrugging up and down,
rolling forward and backward
Moving arms: swinging, stretching up,
sideways, circling
Moving hands: waving, clapping, opening and
closing fists
Simple coordination: head and arm movements
together
Activity: "Simon Says" with upper body
movements

weeks.topic: Moving Our Body Parts (Part 2): Lower Body knees, feet, toes
weeks.content:
Identifying lower body parts: waist, hips, legs,
Bending at the waist: forward, sideways,
backward (carefully)
Moving hips: side to side, circular motions
Moving legs: lifting knees, kicking gently,
stepping
Moving feet: tiptoeing, stamping, standing on
one foot
Moving toes: wiggling, curling
Balance activities: standing on one leg, walking
on a line
Activity: Follow-the-leader movement game

weeks.topic: Moving Our Body Parts (Part 3): Whole Body Movements Basic locomotor movements:
weeks.content:
Combining upper and lower body movements
- Walking: forward, backward, sideways
- Running: in place, short distances
-Jumping: two feet together, hopping on one
foot
- Skipping: combining step and hop
- Galloping: like a horse
Stretching exercises: reaching high, bending
low, stretching wide
Activity: Movement stations, obstacle course

weeks.topic: Moving Our Body Parts (Part 4): Movement Patterns and sideways, up, down Coordination Movement speeds: fast and slow, starting and
weeks.content:
Movement directions: forward, backward,
stopping
Movement pathways: straight lines, curves,
zigzag
Body shapes: tall/stretched, wide/spread,
small/curled, twisted
Coordinating movements: marching (arms and
legs together), crawling
Simple rhythmic movements: clapping to beat,
moving to music
Activity: Movement to music, creative
movement exploration

Understanding running: faster than walking,
both feet off ground
Proper running posture: body slightly forward,
arms swinging, looking ahead
Running techniques: lifting knees, landing on
balls of feet
Starting position: ready position, listening for
signal
Running in straight lines: staying in lane/path
Short-distance running: 20-30 meters
Activity: Running races, relay races (simple)

weeks.topic: Athletics: Running (Part 2) and Jumping time, Mr. Wolf?"
weeks.content:
Running games: chase games, tag, "What's the
Starting and stopping on command
Introduction to jumping: taking off and landing
on two feet
Types of jumps: jumping in place, jumping
forward, jumping over low objects
Jumping techniques: bending knees, swinging
arms, soft landing
Hopping: jumping on one foot
Activity: Jumping games, hopscotch, jumping
rope (introduction)

weeks.topic: Games: Traditional/Local Games (Part 1) played for fun
weeks.content:
Understanding games: activities with rules,
Nigerian traditional games:
-"Suwe" (Hopscotch): drawing pattern, hopping
in squares
- "Catcher" (Tag): one person chases others
- "Hide and Seek" (Oga): hiding and finding
Rules of each game: how to play, how to win,
fair play
Taking turns and sharing
Activity: Playing traditional games in small
groups

weeks.topic: Games: Traditional/Local Games (Part 2) -"Ten-Ten" (Clapping game): rhythmic hand
weeks.content:
More Nigerian games:
clapping
- "Tinko-Tinko" (Ball bouncing game)
- "Ayo" or "Ludo" (Board games - introduction)
- Skipping rope games
Simple ball games: throwing and catching,
rolling
Importance of playing games: exercise, fun,
making friends
Being a good sport: not fighting, congratulating
winners, trying again
Activity: Class game tournament, rotating
through different games

view and practice: Body movements,
running, jumping, local games

actical assessment: Demonstrate movements,
participate in games
